database_migration_summary: M1.3a retains the minimal accounts.User and adds an authentication generation, native-session generation snapshots, deterministic digest-only email-action derivation metadata, and the durable provider-neutral AuthEmailDelivery outbox. No learner, entitlement, curriculum, assessment, billing, or other business model exists.

Real provider email, Heroku proxy behavior, native device keychain/simulator/store builds, and universal/app links remain unverified.
